output.one_liner: Gumroad is an ecommerce platform that enables creators to sell digital products directly to customers.

auth.notes: Supports OAuth2 managed by Composio and personal/static bearer token access. Access tokens generated from Gumroad app dashboard.

evidence.snippet: Keep your access token safe and confidential, like a password.

access.notes: Developers can create an application and generate API tokens directly from their Gumroad account without payment requirements.

evidence.snippet: To generate an access token, follow these steps:
Use the "Generate access token" button to get your access token.

buildability.rationale: Free self-serve credentials, fully documented REST API with 13 tools, webhook support, and existing Composio toolkit confirm ready buildability.
